function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

message.content:
**Pet‑friendly train stations in Miami** | Station | Operator | Pet policy (as of 2024) | Notes | |---------|----------|------------------------|-------| | **Amtrak – Miami Station** (South 1st St & 1st Ave) | Amtrak | • Small pets (≤ 20 lb) allowed in carriers in the passenger car.
• Larger pets must be in a carrier and may require a fee.
• Pets are not allowed in the station lobby or on the platform unless they are in a carrier. | • Check Amtrak’s “Pet Policy” page before traveling.
• Bring a leash, water bowl, and waste bags.
• Some trains (e.g., Silver Service) allow pets in the “Pet Friendly” car. | | **Miami Central Station** (for local commuter rail, e.g., Metrorail) | Miami-Dade Transit | • Pets are generally **not** allowed on the Metrorail, but a few stations allow small dogs on a leash in the station building (e.g., the “Pet Friendly” area at the Miami Central Station). | • Verify with the station staff; policies can change. | | **Miami International Airport (MIA) – Amtrak & Greyhound** | Amtrak & Greyhound | • Greyhound allows pets in carriers on the bus; Amtrak allows pets in carriers on the train. | • Not a traditional “train station,” but many travelers use the airport for intercity travel. | ### How to confirm the pet policy 1. **Amtrak** – Visit the [Amtrak Pet Policy](https://www.amtrak.com/pets) page or call 1‑800‑AMTRAK (1‑800‑226‑4727). 2. **Miami-Dade Transit** – Call the Metrorail customer service line at 305‑347‑2000. 3. **Greyhound** – Check the Greyhound website or call 1‑800‑GREYHOUND (1‑800‑473‑4568). ### Quick Tips for Traveling with Pets - **Carrier size**: Must fit under the seat or in the designated pet area. - **Documentation**: Some carriers require proof of vaccination. - **Fees**: Amtrak charges a $25 pet fee per pet per trip (subject to change). - **Leash**: Keep your pet on a leash when moving through the station. - **Clean up**: Bring waste bags and clean up after your pet.
